# Erg Hamada (`erg_hamada`) — spec sheet

|---|---|---|---|

## Design note

A desert racer that survived a fortnight of dunes and wants more. Permanent four-wheel drive, locked-up diffs and 35 cm of travel make it unstoppable off the road and absurdly fast across rough ground; it lands jumps that would break the pre-runner. On smooth tarmac it is wide, tall and draggy, the restrictor caps it well below supercar speeds, and the locked drivetrain scrubs in tight turns.

## How this car breaks

Chromoly tubular spaceframe with an integral roll cage — the strongest cell in the roster — under thin composite panels that shatter and fall off. The long-travel wishbones and twin dampers hang outside the body and break in offset hits; the spare wheels in the rear bay soak up rear impacts. Durability class 5: it keeps driving with half its bodywork gone.

## Sources (type)

- series technical regulations for 2020s rally-raid prototypes (minimum weight, track, restrictor, travel)
- team-published engine and suspension data for restricted 5.0 L V8 rally-raid cars
- stage telemetry figures for the class (top speed, braking)
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, multi-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Engine

5.0 L DOHC 32-valve V8, naturally aspirated through an air restrictor, dry sump, desert air filtration. Class-typical rally-raid prototype V8 under its air restrictor (~308 kW at 6000 rpm, 560 N·m at 3500-4000) per series technical regulations; the restrictor caps the top end, the long-runner intake fattens the middle.

## Drivetrain

6-speed sequential (dog engagement), permanent 4WD with a fixed 50/50 split (no centre diff by the rules), plated LSDs front and rear. Layout **AWD, 50 % front**; front diff: clutch LSD, preload 100 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.40; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 100 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.40. Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 900 N·m. Shift time 0.15 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.31 | 14.23 | 76 |
| 2 | 2.31 | 9.93 | 109 |
| 3 | 1.73 | 7.44 | 146 |
| 4 | 1.38 | 5.93 | 183 |
| 5 | 1.13 | 4.86 | 223 |
| 6 | 0.95 | 4.08 | 266 |

Final drive 4.30, reverse 3.00. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.457 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.40 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 479 kg | 1.10 Hz | 22900 N/m | 2650 N·s/m | 3980 N·s/m | 0.35 m |
| Rear | 437 kg | 1.20 Hz | 24900 N/m | 2640 N·s/m | 3960 N·s/m | 0.35 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.0°/g with 52% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.601 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 142726 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 50500 F / 54801 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **5400 F / 3100 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.0°/g, front share 52%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 6.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 362 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 38 mm + 36 mm → A = 34.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 156 mm, pad μ = 0.48: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.48·100 bar·34.1 cm²·0.156 m = **5105 N·m**
- Rear: 340 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 36 mm → A = 22.7 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 145 mm, pad μ = 0.46: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.46·100 bar·22.7 cm²·0.145 m = **3034 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 3568 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.43×), rear needs 1168 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.59×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1670 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.645** → delivered 5100 N·m front / 1668 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 3410 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 14.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 13.0 m → outer-front path radius 6.34 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.53 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.585 rad (33.5°)** (outer 28.3°, inner 40.7° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.8 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/erg_hamada.json`)

270 nodes, 1767 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id erg_hamada --profile suv --width 2.3 --length 4.6 --height 1.95 --wheelbase 3.0 --mass 464.9 --car-mass 2113.2 --clearance 0.32 --front-overhang 0.85 --strength 1.3` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 5).
- Era `2020s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Chromoly tubular spaceframe with integral roll cage: 440 passenger-cell beams (cabin, sills, pillars, roof rails, cross-members) × 1.80 section.
- Body-on-frame: 18 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 16 under-cab rail beams → hss 2.97e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Luggage bay: 5 Cabin nodes behind the rear seatback (y < -1.60 m, rear axle −0.10 m) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell ends at the seatback, as on a real two-box body.
